{{Quote|Two years, six months, and three days ago, a solar flare burst from our sun that was over ten light-minutes long. A huge, unheard-of, massive eruption, far greater than any the star had produced in ten million years. A flare that jetted forth with such power and force that Equanus was ''cooked''.|[[Klo Merit]], to [[Jos Vondar]]|<ref name="JH" />}}
'''Nharl''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Nharl system]], a part of the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by five [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Equanus]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Equani]].<ref name="JH" />
